peers.name: KEYCORP /NEW/
peers.rationale: Super-regional bank with similar commercial and consumer banking mix and comparable asset size to MTB, both Northeast/Midwest footprint lenders.

peers.name: CITIZENS FINANCIAL GROUP INC/RI
peers.rationale: Northeast-based super-regional bank with overlapping commercial banking and retail branch footprint comparable to MTB's Mid-Atlantic/Northeast presence.

peers.name: FIFTH THIRD BANCORP
peers.rationale: Similarly sized regional bank with diversified commercial and consumer lending, useful for multiple comparison though footprint skews more Midwest.

peers.name: HUNTINGTON BANCSHARES INC /MD/
peers.rationale: Comparable-scale regional bank with strong commercial banking focus and overlapping Midwest/Northeast markets relevant to MTB's lending mix.

peers.name: REGIONS FINANCIAL CORP
peers.rationale: Super-regional bank of similar size with diversified commercial and retail banking, though its Southeast focus differs from MTB's Northeast base.

peers.name: ZIONS BANCORPORATION, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION /UT/
peers.rationale: Regional commercial bank with comparable community/commercial banking economics, though smaller scale and Western footprint reduce direct overlap.

peers.name: PNC FINANCIAL SERVICES GROUP, INC.
peers.rationale: Larger super-regional bank with overlapping Mid-Atlantic footprint and similar diversified commercial/consumer banking model, useful upper-end comparable.
